newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait's bourse extends mid-year results deadline.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait's bourse extends mid-year results deadline.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) has extended by 10 days an August 15 deadline set for listed firms to issue their mid-year results, a KSE official said on Tuesday.
"They have 10 more days or they are suspended from trade," the officials said.
Nine of a total of 71 companies listed on the Exchange did not announce their mid-year results by that date.
By law, listed firms are required to announce their annual and bi-annual result to the KSE.
Dealers said the step is a routine measure by the KSE, which traditionally avoids suspension.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the Exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
